title: Hoʻonani Village housing and well funding
summary: A member moved on April 24 to set aside up to $9 million in excise tax funds for well and water work at the Hoʻonani Village project. The member who made the motion said the aim is to help provide housing for the community sooner. Another member noted the project can return for a budget amendment to remove the condition if it becomes unfeasible.
